description: Expected bullets after the Conservative-mode filter pipeline (nonfiction golden file). Same 6 grounded bullets survive; the thinking-process bullet (#7) is dropped (always-active filter even in conservative).
expected_surviving_bullets: Casing is the systematic observation of a location to develop a mental map of entrances and exits.
The operative should avoid staring and use quick glances that capture details without drawing attention.
Establishing a baseline is essential before observing deviations in activity patterns.
A baseline is the normal pattern of activity in the environment.
Mirroring is a technique where the operative subtly matches the body language of the subject.
The operative should mirror posture, gesture frequency, and speech pace.
